An upright wheel with a highlighted radius and diameter and a removable circumference tape. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Wheel: warm paper disc (roughness ~0.5). Center: small solid warm-ink sphere. Radius and diameter strokes: thin warm-ink strips. Circumference tape: thin warm paper strip around the rim, peelable into a straight line. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). No emissive channels — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: circles, radius, diameter, circumference and pi — a flat wheel with highlighted radius and diameter, a peelable circumference tape, a roll/unroll demo, and a drag control to resize.

GEOMETRY: An upright flat wheel standing on a board. Center dot O; a radius stroke center-to-rim tagged 'r'; a diameter stroke across through center tagged 'd = 2r'; a tape hugging the rim labeled circumference. 'Unroll' peels the tape off and straightens it into a line along the board; 'roll' moves the wheel one full turn so its travel equals the straightened tape. Drag on the rim grows or shrinks the wheel; radius/diameter/tags update live.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) board; (2) wheel disc; (3) radius + diameter strokes; (4) circumference tape + tags.

CAMERA: three-quarter from front, slightly above, frames wheel and tape; labels legible. Budget 5-9k triangles. Named nodes: Board, Wheel, CenterDot, RadiusStroke, DiameterStroke, CircumferenceTape, RollMechanism, Tags. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
